from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,time,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_bank_accepted_bill_discount_source_qualification_v1")
receipts=json.loads((OUT/"source_identity_and_download_route_receipts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
row=next(x for x in receipts if x["source_id"]=="official_entity_article_list")
assert row["response_code"]=="000" and len(row["article_data"])==1
article_id=row["article_data"][0]["articleId"]
assert article_id=="WZ202008141294017267251433472"
assert not (OUT/"official_entity_detail_receipt.json").exists()
assert json.loads((OUT/"source_request_budget_after_identity.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["additional_requests_remaining"]==1
stamp=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai"))
payload={"requestTime":stamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),"requestSystem":"shcpe-cos",
    "requestNo":int(time.time()*1000),"articleId":article_id}
url="http://www.shcpe.com.cn/shcpe-cos/article/detail"
receipt={"source_id":"official_entity_article_detail","requested_at":stamp.isoformat(),
    "url":url,"method":"POST","request_json":payload,"attempts":1,
    "route":"同一已取得官方文章目录中的articleId，按公开loadAboutDetail方法读取",
    "additional_request_index":12}
try:
    response=requests.post(url,json=payload,headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0",
        "Referer":"http://www.shcpe.com.cn/content/shcpe/about.html",
        "Content-Type":"application/json;charset=UTF-8"},timeout=(10,25),stream=True)
    chunks=[]; size=0
    for chunk in response.iter_content(65536):
        size+=len(chunk)
        if size>1048576: raise ValueError("说明页超过固定1MiB预算")
        chunks.append(chunk)
    raw=b"".join(chunks)
    response.close()
    path=OUT/"sources/official_entity_article_detail.bin"
    assert not path.exists(); path.write_bytes(raw)
    receipt.update({"status_code":response.status_code,"final_url":response.url,
        "path":str(path).replace("\\","/"),"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        "successfully_received":True})
    body=json.loads(raw)
    receipt["response_code"]=body.get("code")
    data=body.get("data")
    if isinstance(data,dict):
        receipt["article_keys"]=list(data)
        receipt["article_title"]=data.get("title")
        receipt["publishTime"]=data.get("publishTime")
        receipt["updateTime"]=data.get("updateTime")
        receipt["content"]={k:v for k,v in data.items() if any(s in k.lower() for s in ("content","body"))}
        text=BeautifulSoup(" ".join(str(v) for v in receipt["content"].values()),"html.parser").get_text(" ",strip=True)
        receipt["plain_text"]=text
except Exception as error:
    receipt.update({"successfully_received":False,"error_type":type(error).__name__,"error":str(error)})
receipt["completed_at"]=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
(OUT/"official_entity_detail_receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({k:receipt.get(k) for k in ("status_code","response_code","article_title","publishTime","updateTime",
    "article_keys","plain_text","error_type")},ensure_ascii=False)[:4600])
